title: Setting Up a Complete Modern AI Coding Environment
body: ## cc-switch > Add the CC Switch Homebrew tap: > `brew tap farion1231/ccswitch` > Then install it: > `brew install --cask cc-switch` ### If you are tired of confirming permissions, start with this flag to skip the unnecessary prompts: ``` claude --dangerously-skip-permissions ``` ## Installing common Claude Code skills ### Method 1 Download the archive from https://skillsmp.com/zh, unzip it, and drop the folder into the right system directory. ### Method 2 Start Claude and run: ``` /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills /plugin install skill-creator@claude-plugins-official ``` Then ask it: "use skill-creator to create a skill called deploy-check that runs a pre-deployment checklist". (skill-creator is Anthropic's official skill development kit; it helps you build your own custom skills quickly.) ### Installing web-access (web browsing and search) The web-access skill lets Claude Code reach the internet: search for current information, browse pages, extract data. ``` /plugin marketplace add browserbase/skills /plugin install browse@browserbase ``` ### Installing playwright-cli (browser automation) The playwright-cli skill lets Claude Code drive a real browser and automate things: fill in forms, click buttons, take screenshots. ``` npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest playwright install chromium playwright-cli install --skills ``` ### Installing superpowers (a full development workflow) superpowers is the most popular Claude Code plugin at the moment. It supplies a complete software development workflow — requirements, design, implementation, testing — and guides the model through best practice at each stage. ``` /plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace /plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace ``` ### Install the LSP for whatever languages you use It helps Claude Code understand the repository. ``` /plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official /plugin install pyright-lsp@claude-plugins-official /plugin install gopls-lsp@claude-plugins-official ``` ## Image and video generation skills Put the downloaded zip in: - macOS: `~/.claude/skills/` - Windows: `C:\Users\\.claude\skills\` The `secret-key` inside the skill has expired — remember to have Claude Code replace it with your own. ## Prompts for long-running tasks Put them under the project. If your project is `C:\Users\\proj`, then they go in `C:\Users\\proj\prompts` (remember to unzip). The example prompt translates OpenClaw's TypeScript into Python. Adjust it to whatever your project needs. (The prompts folder is under Desktop/AI.)
